plan.status: research; partial automatic H/A references only; no D fitting or fresh final holdout
plan.duration_scale: coefficient-fit matches only; equal-match mean of uncensored interior H/A spell means
plan.utility_target: positive if one proposed split improves exact global mean spellF1; unknown/censored proposal intervals excluded
plan.training_loss: per-match equal-weight logistic loss; L2=0.1; not a differentiable direct spellF1 loss

plan.threshold_selection: mean calibration-match spellF1, then H/A macroF1, then higher threshold; disabled baseline always included
plan.primary_comparison: duration plus learned utility verifier versus same fold-fitted duration decoder
plan.final_fit: first ten development matches coefficients/duration scale; last two threshold calibration
